characters.name: Karthik
characters.appearance: Middle-aged Indian male, stocky build, medium complexion. He has short salt-and-pepper hair and a matching beard. He wears a silver chain necklace and a small hoop earring in his left ear.
characters.wardrobe: Initially wears a dark blue button-down shirt. Later changes to a bright red button-down shirt. Wears dark aviator sunglasses in the final scene.
characters.demeanor: Highly expressive, ranging from stressed and confused to maniacally laughing, and finally confident and swaggering.

characters.name: Miss Nova
characters.appearance: Not visible; represents the persona behind the chat interface.

scenes.supernova_script:
Karthik says: Learning English feels impossible. I spent years on grammar books but still freeze in job interviews.
Miss Nova says: That is because you only read, you never speak. I am Miss Nova from Supernova AI. I analyze your exact level and build a personalized plan just for you.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hooks the viewer with the relatable failure of old methods and high-stakes interview anxiety.
- Introduces Miss Nova and lands the personalization beat (a) immediately.
- Replaces the seed's hard price with the core AI teacher mechanism.

scenes.supernova_script:
Karthik says: But I make so many mistakes when I speak! People always laugh at me.
Miss Nova says: Not here. You can make a thousand mistakes at 3 a.m., and I will correct you without ever judging you.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Matches the manic, hair-pulling visual to the intense anxiety of being mocked for broken English.
- Lands the crucial privacy and no-judgement beat (b).
- Pre-sells retention by removing the fear of speaking out loud.

scenes.supernova_script:
Karthik says: Really? And what if I do not understand a word?
Miss Nova says: I explain the logic in your own language so it finally makes sense. Stop scrolling and practice just fifteen minutes a day.
Karthik says: I am installing Supernova AI right now.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Resolves the narrative with confidence, matching the visual swagger of putting on sunglasses.
- Lands mother-tongue logic (g) and the negative/positive time anchors.
- Ends with a clean, price-free CTA to install the app.
